sources.label: BlackRock complete holdings CSV as of October 1, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The October 1, 2026 holdings CSV publishes 13 Treasury bills with market value USD 40,853,218.07 and three overnight Treasury repos totaling USD 9,000,000, for USD 49,853,218.07 total listed holdings. Percentages use market value rather than the CSV's par percentages: 81.947% bills and 18.053% repo after rounding. Repo counterparties are BofA Securities (USD 5m), Credit Agricole CIB (USD 2m) and J.P. Morgan Securities (USD 2m). Bills mature October 6 through December 24, 2026; the 93-day maximum is the prospectus mandate, not WAM. The fund page separately reports WAM/WAL 28 days and daily/weekly liquid assets 100% as of October 1. These issuer observations do not reconcile the October 1 portfolio to October 3 on-chain shares or provide financial assurance.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: October 1, 2026 itemized holdings, normalized by published security market values
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current whole-token liability reconciliation and account-level custody, collateral and recovery agreements remain unavailable. Portfolio and token stock have different observation dates; their difference is not a measured shortfall. Named auditors do not establish a signed financial report.
